quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris was awarded a follow-on contract from Lockheed Martin valued at $250 million to manufacture standard-range GMLRS propulsion units, at the highest quantity in program history, to be fulfilled in the new 60,000-square-foot Arsenal of Freedom facility in Camden, Arkansas. L3Harris is the program's solid rocket motor provider, also manufactures GMLRS's electronic safe-and-arm device and proximity sensor, and has doubled GMLRS solid rocket motor output in recent years.
